messages:
samir: quick question — I need to debug a customer trace in project prod-payments. Some log entries include raw user IDs (PII) in a few lines. What's the minimum IAM/console role I should request to view the log entries for that project temporarily? I only need list/get on logs for ~1–2 hours.

jess: prefer not to give broad Project Viewer. For logs-only access, either use roles/logging.viewer or a custom role scoped to logging permissions. Best practice: short-lived binding (JIT) with explicit justification.

ben: +1 to short-lived custom role. If you can, request a role that only has: 
```
- logging.logEntries.list
- logging.logEntries.get
```
scoped to prod-payments. Avoid roles/viewer since that exposes config metadata.

samir: ok — if I do a temporary binding, what's the exact gcloud syntax? Is this safe?

jess: don't run a long-lived gcloud add-iam-policy-binding yourself. Instead open a security JIT request or ping me. If you need a one-off quick command for local testing (non-prod creds), this is the shape: 
```bash
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding prod-payments \\  --member='user:samir@redwood.ai' \\  --role='roles/logging.viewer' \
```
But again, don't run that for production — request via JIT so we can audit and TTL it.

sec-bot: Automated reminder: Access >30 minutes requires a ticket with justification and TTL. See https://redwood.internal/security/jit for the form.

alice: alternative: export the specific log stream to an ephemeral BigQuery dataset owned by observability, then we can grant you bigquery.dataViewer on that dataset for a day. That avoids touching project-level IAM.

samir: that could work — the trace id is trace-0a7c. I only need to inspect 3 log lines. I'll open a JIT request and include the trace id + reason + TTL=2h.

jess: thanks — when you open the ticket, include: project, trace id, exact time window, and whether you need download/retention. We'll stamp the binding and record the audit. If anything looks sensitive we'll redact before you get access.

ben: FYI if you find raw IDs that look like account numbers, follow the PII-handling checklist in the ticket. Don't copy/paste IDs into external channels.

samir: noted. opening ticket now and pinging @jess. thanks all :thumbsup:

jess: once the JIT is approved I'll post the binding details in the ticket and add the expiration timestamp.

sec-bot: Automated note: ticket #SEC-4321 created by samir, TTL requested 2h. Awaiting approval.
